messages:
Maya R.: Seeing a support escalation where a customer’s signed requests keep going to eu-west even though their failover policy shows us-east primary. Latency+auth 401s. Anyone seen signed-affinity stick to a stale region before?
Priya (support): Customer reported billing jump too — lots of cross-region egress. They say SDK v0.12.1, browser clients. Happened after a policy roll last night.
Devon (SRE): Quick hypothesis: SDK uses a client-side seed to sign affinity cookies/headers. If the seed rotated but clients cached old policy version + old seed, signatures could still validate at an edge that has stale policy mapping, routing them to the old region.
Maya R.: Repro steps customer provided: 1) Login -> get session cookie with route_sig. 2) Wait ~6h. 3) Request endpoint: routed to EU and 401 sporadically. They said forcing a page refresh fixes it.
Jorge (eng): Can you paste a sample header and the server-side verification error?
Priya (support): From customer logs (sanitized):
```
X-Route-Sig: v2:seed=0429a7;sig=ab12...;policy_v=174
Error: route validation failed: policy_v mismatch (expected 176), fallback->eu-west
```
Cleo (infra): That error means the edge accepted the signature format but our routing layer resolved to a policy id that no longer matches the client. Looks like the client signature included a policy_v tag. If seed rotation + policy bump happened but not propagated to some CDN edge caches, signatures could still be considered valid by old mapping.
Devon (SRE): I pulled edge cache logs: some POPs still had policy bundle ts=2023-11-02T... (older). The policy service pushed new bundle at 2023-11-04T..., but CDN invalidation for policy bundles failed on a subset due to rate limit.
Maya R.: So path: client had cookie signed with old seed + old policy id -> request hits stale POP which maps that policy id to eu-west -> we route to eu-west (wrong) -> origin rejects token for us-east account settings -> 401 and retries cause billing and egress.
Jorge (eng): Agreed. Root cause is twofold: (1) seed rotation & policy bump were atomic server-side but (2) CDN invalidation for policy bundles was partial. Also SDK caching TTL was long (24h) in older client.
Priya (support): Customer is asking for immediate mitigation. What can we do right now?
Devon (SRE): Short-term mitigations:
- Force CDN invalidation for policy bundles across all POPs (we can run a wider purge).
- Emit a temporary routing override: map old policy_v -> new policy_v at the edge layer for 12h.
- Tell customer to clear session cookies (page refresh) or rotate client sessions.
Maya R.: I can send a support note with the cookie clear instructions and ask to rotate sessions; but ops needs the purge/override steps.
Cleo (infra): I'm running the purge now (command):
```
# purge policy bundles globally
infractl cdn purge --type=policy-bundle --all-pop --reason "policy-176-rollout-purge"
```
Cleo (infra): Kickoff returned job id cdn-purge-8812. Monitoring edge health, will post when all pops report new bundle.
Devon (SRE): I'll also push a temporary routing alias: map policy_v=174 -> policy_v=176 at the routing layer for 8 hours. Command:
```
routingctl alias add --from-policy 174 --to-policy 176 --ttl 28800 --note "temp-for-stale-clients"
```
ops-bot: routing alias applied: alias-912 created, expires in 8h.
Priya (support): Customer notified to clear cookies and restart clients. They confirmed partial improvement after manual refresh.
Maya R.: Post-mortem action items we should track:
- Make policy bundle invalidation observable (missing pops alert).
- SDK: reduce default cache TTL for policy/seed to 1h for browser SDKs and add auto-refresh on 401s.
- Gate seed rotation to wait until CDN invalidation completes (or use staged seeds with overlap window).
- Add telemetry to detect policy_v mismatches and automatically serve a 'refresh-session' header.
Jorge (eng): I'll open a ticket for SDK changes + a runtime feature to serve Retry-Refresh header when we detect old-policy signatures.
Maya R.: Thanks. Leave this thread if you want to add notes. I'll update support case after CDNs finish purge and alias expires. :thumbsup:
